system.description:
Lore: Relic Lantern

A common tool of Ten-Towns militia and monster hunters alike, cheap enough to hand out to every watch post that can't afford a real scout.

A hooded lantern burning 6 Hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light to Near and dim light to Far. Each lantern of tracking is bound to a single Being Type, rolled once when it's found and never changed. While within roughly 300 feet of any Being of that Type, its flame burns bright green - though it doesn't pinpoint a direction or distance.

d8Being Type
1Artificial
2Beast
3Cryptid
4Fae
5Humanlike
6Outer
7Primordial
8Undead

It has the following Powers:

  • Moonlit II: Sheds bright light to Near and dim light to Far, burning 6 Hours on a pint of oil.
  • Tracking: Its flame burns bright green while within roughly 300 feet of any Being of its bound Type. It gives no direction or distance.

Value: 200g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
